purpose: Whole-organism external living reconstruction informed by Siphusauctum fossils. concept_interpretation: Inspected actual concept pixels: enclosed six-lobed egg-shaped calyx, terminal opening, long stem and low expanded holdfast adopted. Concept front shows more than three visible lower holes and ambiguity in total count. Resolve exactly SIX evenly spaced basal ports in complete circumference, not extra decorative holes. Freeze external full organism, not open tulip petals. Calyx occupies z.11-.22m, maximum radius.035m, slightly six-lobed. Stem outer sleeve tapers and ends above low bulbous flattened holdfast, inner stem continues to holdfast. Shell has real thickness and six rectangular-oval inset through-openings with inner wall; terminal anus smaller than basal calyx width. No invented external arms/tentacles. Topology unseen rear repeats same coherent sixfold plan. Opaque external surface hides internal organs without claiming absence.
